info.title: JeRyu Web Forge API
info.description: BFF for the JeRyu Web Forge. Versioned under /api/v1/. See WEB_WORK_CLAUDE.md §35.7 for the canonical route map.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only events with `seq > since` are returned.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Exact scope or prefix to filter by (e.g. `repo.gitlab/x/y`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max events to return; clamped to the buffer capacity.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Byte offset for incremental fetch; clients pass the previous
response's `next_cursor`. Phase 4: log is fetched in full and the
cursor slices it client-side (best-effort).

200.description: Raw file bytes; Content-Type reflects detected MIME

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path within the tree (default: repo root)

buffer_capacity.description:
Buffer capacity at fetch time. Lets the FE detect that the rolling
window has wrapped (a sudden drop in `total` vs. recent reads).

buffer_len.description: Number of events currently held in the buffer.

bytes.description: Log bytes as UTF-8 (lossy if invalid).

next_cursor.description:
Byte offset where the next fetch should resume; absent when the log
is fully drained.

MergePassport.description: Canonical Merge Passport verdict (FINAL spec §6.7 + §35.2.4 12-gate list).

MergePassportBlocker.description:
One blocker entry in the Merge Passport. `code` aligns with the §35.2.4
canonical gate list (e.g. `passport_blocked_approvals`,
`passport_blocked_policy_sha`) so the UI can target explanations.

MergeRequestDetail.description:
Full MR view returned by `GET /api/v1/repos/{repo_id}/merge-requests/{iid}`.

Carries the same posture summary fields plus the Merge Passport verdict
(per §35.2.4) so the UI's `MergeGatePanel` can render gate-by-gate detail.

passport_hash.description:
`passport_hash` mirrors `summary.passport_hash` for ergonomics so the
UI doesn't need to dive into `summary` to display the verdict identity.

Stable hash of the most recent Merge Passport evaluation. Per §35.1.14
the backend persists `passport_hash` on `web_merge_requests` after each
Passport recompute so we can detect re-evaluation drift across replays.
`None` when the Passport has not been computed yet (e.g. brand-new MR).

sanitizer_version.description:
`jeryu-md-sanitizer.v<n>` — ammonia allowlist identity (per §35.1.4).
Optional for backward compatibility with v1 caches; W-B-08 will fill
it in mandatorily once the sanitizer pipeline ships.

RepositoryId.description:
Opaque, stable repository identifier used on the API surface.

Per §35.1.2 the canonical key in `/api/v1/repos/{repo_id}` is the opaque
`id` (a UUID-shaped string persisted in `web_repositories.id`). The
human-readable triple (`host`, `owner`, `name`) is preserved for display
in the SPA so we can keep pretty URLs while the backend uses the stable id.

id.description: Opaque stable identifier (UUID-shaped). Canonical in API paths.

body_html.description:
Sanitized HTML rendered server-side via the markdown service. Optional
because raw fetches may skip rendering; the UI re-sanitizes anyway.

oneOf.description: Present when this comment is an inline ``` ```suggestion``` ``` block.

SearchResults.description:
Wire shape returned by `/api/v1/search`. Each field is a separate
vector so the FE can render per-section panels without scanning a
generic union list.

SettingsDiffPreview.description:
Preview output: what would change if the patch were applied, plus an
initial cut at blast-radius messaging. Phase 2 returns a stub blast
radius; the full implementation lands with W-B-* (counts branches/MRs
affected by visibility changes, default-branch swap, etc.).

SettingsPatch.description:
Settings patch wire-format. RFC 7396 merge semantics — only fields that
appear in the JSON body are updated; absent fields are left unchanged.
Mirrors the host adapter's `HostRepositorySettingsPatch` for the subset
of fields the BFF currently supports.

scope.description:
Granular topic per §35.1.15, e.g. `global.activity`, `repo.{id}`,
`mr.{id}`, `agent.{id}`, `cache.{id}`. Backend re-checks each scope
against the viewer's perms on every `Subscribe` frame (§35.1.6).

tui.description:
Existing TUI read-model snapshot (`crate::api::read_model::TuiReadModel`).
Serializes inline as a JSON object; the typed schema is opaque from the
web boundary's perspective until W-F-04 lifts derive coverage onto the
TUI read-model.

payload.description: Free-form payload carrying severity, parent, evidence refs, etc.
